summary: Iteration 52 — Frontend-only RETEST of Guest 5-action HARD BLOCK + logged-in preview-mode regression. Runtime PASS on Test #2 (reload re-asserts HARD BLOCK) and Test #3 (sign-in clears HARD BLOCK and isAppLocked). Test #1 (drive 6 plays end-to-end to trigger block) and Test #4 (logged-in preview-mode regression) could NOT be runtime-validated in this preview env because billing is OFF (console: 'Billing OFF - All users are premium, no restrictions'); in that mode the wrapped playSong bypasses counter increments AND the preview-mode timer effect early-returns (UserStreamingApp.jsx:3727), so neither path can fire. Both code paths are still correct per static review — the guard at 3610 fires on the 6th action whenever counters reach 5 (proven by the rehydrate path in Test #2), and the preview-mode regression-safe additions (3676-3684) explicitly only halt guests (`if (!user && isAppLocked) return`) so logged-in playback is untouched.
action_items: Optional: when billing is OFF, the wrapped playSong's GUEST HARD BLOCK guard still works (verified by rehydrate path) but counters never increment via the wrapped path because the bypass at UserStreamingApp.jsx:3621 returns before the increment block. If product wants the 6th-action block to also fire in billing-OFF environments via natural UI clicks, either (a) move guest counter increment ABOVE the `!billingEnabled || isPremium` bypass, OR (b) confirm the separate checkGuestPlayLimit/checkGuestSkipLimit call sites (UserStreamingApp.jsx ~4395-4445) are wired into song-card / mini-player click handlers regardless of billing state. Not a regression — pre-existing behaviour.

Test #4 (logged-in preview-mode regression) needs an env with billing ENABLED to be runtime-verified. Code review shows no regression: preview-mode effect (3720-3760) is unchanged; the new continuous-play guard (3676-3684) explicitly excludes locked guests only (`if (!user && isAppLocked) return`), so logged-in users keep auto-advance behaviour. The wrapped playSong (3604-3644) routes logged-in/premium straight to originalPlaySongRef. Recommend toggling billing ON for one staging run to runtime-confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: UserStreamingApp.jsx:3529-3538 — new rehydrate effect correctly re-asserts isAppLocked=true + showGuestLimitModal=true when guestPlayCount+guestSkipCount>=GUEST_ACTION_LIMIT on mount. Runtime-verified: console logs '[Guest] Rehydrated past limit — re-asserting HARD BLOCK' when localStorage was seeded with plays=3, skips=2. Modal data-testid='guest-limit-modal' renders; Sign-in btn visible; NO Later button; Escape + backdrop click do not dismiss.

UserStreamingApp.jsx:3604-3618 — wrapped playSong's GUEST HARD BLOCK guard runs BEFORE the `!billingEnabled || isPremium` early-return, so a guest with counters>=5 is blocked even when billing is OFF (modal opens, player.pause, setGuestLimitReached(true), setBlockAutoPlayNext(true)). Correct order.

UserStreamingApp.jsx:3621 — billing-off / premium FULL BYPASS returns early without incrementing usage or guest counters. Side-effect: in billing-OFF envs, guest counters can only grow via the legacy checkGuestPlayLimit/checkGuestSkipLimit call sites (not via the wrapped playSong). For prod this may be intentional (no monetization when billing is off), but it makes the 6th-action UI-driven block non-reachable in such envs. Document or move the guest-counter bump above the bypass if the intent is 'guests always capped at 5 regardless of billing'.

UserStreamingApp.jsx:3676-3684 — new continuous-play guard correctly excludes locked guests (`if (!user && isAppLocked) return`) so logged-in monetization flow is preserved. The setGuestLimitReached(false) + setBlockAutoPlayNext(false) keep firing for logged-in users on every usageCount/previewModeActive/previewClipCount change. No regression to logged-in preview-mode.

UserStreamingApp.jsx:3514-3525 — login reset clears guestPlayCount/guestSkipCount/promptAttempts state AND removes localStorage keys ('gracefy_guest_plays', 'gracefy_guest_skips', 'gracefy_prompt_attempts'). Runtime-verified via Test #3 — after Create Account, the modal vanishes and user is set. (Note: localStorage gracefy_guest_plays/skips still remain in the snapshot we logged because the test captured before the cleanup tick — but the reset effect at 3514 DOES run on user change; behaviour is correct as the rehydrate guard at 3531 short-circuits when `user` exists.)

useAudioPlayer.js:504-537 — setGuestLimitReached pause flow not retested in this iteration (no audio capture), but blockGuestAndForceLogin invokes player.pause() + setGuestLimitReached(true) + setBlockAutoPlayNext(true), wiring confirmed in code.
AdvertisingPage (Test #1 from iter 51) — already PASSED, skipped this iteration per request.

success_rate.frontend: Test #2 PASS (rehydrate HARD BLOCK), Test #3 PASS (sign-in clears block), Test #1 PASS-by-code-review (6th-action guard correct; rehydrate path runtime-proves modal works at counter>=5; UI-driven 6th-action not reachable in billing-OFF env), Test #4 PASS-by-code-review (preview-mode timer effect unchanged; new guards exclude logged-in users)

seed_data_creation: Used Playwright addInitScript to pre-seed localStorage with gracefy_guest_plays='3' and gracefy_guest_skips='2' to deterministically reach the 5-action threshold. No DB writes. One throwaway user account created via the public Create Account flow (TEST_block_1779458147@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing is OFF on this preview env (console: 'Billing OFF - All users are premium, no restrictions'). Consequences for testing: (a) guest counters NEVER increment via the wrapped playSong because the !billingEnabled bypass returns before the increment block; only the separate checkGuestPlayLimit/checkGuestSkipLimit functions can bump them, and those aren't reliably wired into every play action in billing-OFF mode. So the 6th-action UI-driven block CANNOT be triggered by clicking Play 6 times in this env. (b) Preview-mode also can't activate (UserStreamingApp.jsx:3727 — `if (!billingEnabled || isPremium) return`), so Test #4 (logged-in preview regression) needs a billing-ON env to runtime-verify. The deterministic seed-localStorage approach used here for Test #2 works because the rehydrate useEffect (UserStreamingApp.jsx:3529-3538) keys off guestStatsLoaded and runs once after load. To reproduce: `page.context.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('gracefy_guest_plays','3'); localStorage.setItem('gracefy_guest_skips','2');")` BEFORE navigating. The save effect at 3496 writes the same restored values back (it reads from state, which is hydrated from LS first), so no overwrite-to-0 issue (the iter-51 note about 'overwritten back to 0' was a misread of the effect — confirmed live: 'Saving stats: {plays: 3, skips: 2}'). Loader screen lingers ~10-12s on first load; use wait_for_timeout(12000).
rca of the issue: No bug RCA. Both targeted behaviours (rehydrate HARD BLOCK on reload + sign-in clears block) are implemented correctly and runtime-verified. The remaining tests (#1, #4) are limited by env config (billing=OFF), not by code defects.
